Guidance & outlook: Date or expected date of commencement of commercial production Not Applicable In case of new companies, expected date of commencement of activities as per project approved by financial institutions appearing in the prospectus Not Applicable Financial performance based on given indicators The Financial performance based on net profit.
Net profit increased from ₹205.86 lakhs in FY 2023-24 to ₹932.09 lakhs in FY 2024 -25 and further to ₹1,150.97 lakhs in FY 2025 -26.
This represents growth of 352.83% in FY 2024 -25 and 23.48% in FY 2025-26, indicating a sustained improvement in the company's profitability.
Growth & demand: The Group reported a Profit After Tax of ₹1,150.78 lakhs for the financial year 2025-26 as compared SHEETAL UNIVERSAL LIMITED ANNUAL REPORT 2025-26 to ₹929.81 lakhs in the previous financial year, registering an increase of ₹220.97 lakhs, representing a growth of 23.77%.

On a Standalone basis, the Total Revenue stood at ₹17,110.06 lakhs as against ₹10,806.52 lakhs in the previous year, registering an increase of ₹6,303.54 lakhs, representing a growth of 58.33% over the previous financial year.

The Company reported a Profit After Tax of ₹1,150.97 lakhs for the financial year 2025 -26 as compared to ₹932.09 lakhs in the previous financial year, registering an increase of ₹218.88 lakhs, representing a growth of 23.48%.
Margins & costs: Reasons for inadequate profits The Company operates in the Agro Industry and its profitability is affected by various factors including raw material prices, availability of agricultural produce, export market conditions, foreign exchange fluctuations, operating costs and prevailing market conditions.

The Company may also experience fluctuations in profitability due to changes in domestic and international market conditions, demand for its products, input costs, competition and other external factors.
